summary.name: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio model pricing
summary.one_liner: A price list page for Alibaba Cloud Model Studio's pay-as-you-go API models, covering the Qwen text generation family (Max, Plus, Flash) across several regions.
keywords: llm api price per million tokens
pay as you go llm api
use_cases: Estimating API costs for Qwen models
Comparing input and output token prices across Qwen tiers
Checking regional pricing for Alibaba Cloud LLM calls
Planning batch or cached inference budgets
Finding free quota eligibility in Singapore
summary.what_it_does: The page lists per-million-token input and output prices for Alibaba Cloud Model Studio's Qwen text models, grouped into Max, Plus and Flash families. Prices are broken out by region, including Singapore (International), China (Beijing), Hong Kong, Germany (Frankfurt), US (Virginia) and Japan (Tokyo), and by thinking versus non-thinking mode. Tiered models charge all tokens in a request at the rate of the tier its total input falls into. The page also notes that batch calls cost 50% of real-time prices, context-cache hits get a discount, and explicit cache creation is billed at 125% of standard input price. Some models include a 1 million token free quota valid 90 days, only in Singapore.
notable: Tiered pricing where the total input token count of a request sets the rate for all its tokens
Batch calls at 50% of real-time price, and context cache discounts that cannot be combined
Regional price lists, with some regions offering night/daytime discounts (night 22:00-08:00 UTC+8)
Singapore-only free quota of 1 million tokens for some models
caveats: Pay-as-you-go by default; the page lists standard prices only and promotions change over time
Free quota is only offered in Singapore and valid for 90 days
Input prices do not include context cache prices
Listed as an earlier model in the awesome-ai-tools entry: qwen3.5-plus is still available but older
